'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' This is probably a bad idea
* '''Username:''' Ardog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
